name: Form
summary: Semantic form wrapper. Owns submission, blur-validation orchestration, and focus-on-first-error. Pairs with Field for the field-level UI. v0.6 ships the lightweight native pattern; v0.7 will add a react-hook-form binding.

onSubmit.description: Called with the FormData after validation passes.

onError.description: Called when submit is blocked by validation.

validate.description: (formData) => Record<fieldName, error>. Called on submit; return non-empty record to block.

density.description: Sets data-density on the form root; nested .lumen-field shells respect it.

children.description: Field, Fieldset, ValidationMessage, and submit Button.

keyboard: Tab — move through fields in DOM order
Enter — submit (when focus is in a single-line input)
Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter — submit (when focus is in a textarea)
rules: On submit failure, focus moves to the first invalid field.
On submit failure, render a ValidationMessage summary at the top of the form with anchor links to each invalid field.
Submit button disabled state must NEVER be the only signal of validation failure — the user must be able to attempt submit and see what's wrong.
Live region for server validation errors uses aria-live=polite by default; assertive only for critical errors that need immediate attention.

do: Validate on blur after first interaction; switch to onChange after first error per field.
On submit, validate everything — focus the first invalid field, render a summary at top.
Pair Form with Field — let Field own field-level UI; Form owns flow + submit + summary.
Set autoComplete='off' only for sensitive forms (one-time passcode entry); default keep on.
dont: Don't disable the submit button as the only signal of failed validation — the user should be able to submit and see errors.
Don't validate on every keystroke before first interaction — wait for blur.
Don't suppress browser autofill for known-safe fields (name, email, address). Autofill is an a11y feature.

changelog.note: Initial release. Lightweight native FormElement wrapper with onSubmit, validate, focus-on-first-error orchestration, and a density mode hook. v0.7 adds react-hook-form binding.
